query: WITH filtered_violations AS (SELECT status_description, actual_fine FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation WHERE status_description IN ('Issued to violator and paid', 'Issued to violator but un-paid') AND status_description NOT LIKE 'Cancelled due to%') SELECT status_description, SUM(actual_fine) AS total_fine FROM filtered_violations GROUP BY status_description LIMIT 1200
raw_question: كم تبلغ قيمة المخالفات المرورية المسددة وغير المسددة حالياً؟
